readback_body:
## Description

After #3829 shipped the conversation-first Claude Code App workspace, the App sections of two canonical browser regression specs still drive the removed pre-#3829 surface. Any Issue whose E2E plan selects these IDs fails at PR head, even when the product UI is healthy.

The two specs and their failing App sections:

- `e2e/tests/browser/transcript-geometry.spec.ts` — “transcript raw records on App (#3726)”: after `workspace-tool-claude-code` it waits for `claude-code-workspace`, which the App no longer renders (the new root is `claude-code-app-workspace` / `claude-app-root`).
- `e2e/tests/browser/conversation-list-state.spec.ts` — “App push composition”: after the stale-list Retry it waits for `conversation-show-list`, which only exists in the Web `ConversationView`; the App now exposes the list through `claude-app-all-conversations` or Browse → Conversations.

## Reproduction

Exact-head E2E selection for any Issue whose `E2E Verification` lists `conversation-list-state` and `transcript-geometry`. Observed on PR #3900 (Issue #3779): run `44260539381`, job `134656197299`; all three retries failed for both specs.

Locally (fixture-only, no Rust stack):

```bash
cd web && npm run build
cd e2e && E2E_RUNTIME_WEB_ONLY=1 CI=1 NESSION_TARGET_SHA=$(git -C .. rev-parse HEAD) \
  npx playwright test tests/browser/conversation-list-state.spec.ts tests/browser/transcript-geometry.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts --reporter=line
```

## Root Cause

Verified by code search and the failure page snapshot:

- #3829 introduced `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/ClaudeCodeAppWorkspace.tsx` as the App presentation. Its root is `data-testid="claude-code-app-workspace"`, the conversation root is `claude-app-root`, and resources are pushed as `claude-app-layer-*` / `claude-app-*` layers behind a `claude-browse-sheet`.
- The two specs still assert the old `claude-code-workspace` master/detail surface and the Web-only `conversation-show-list` control. They were not migrated with #3829.
- The staging push E2E selection (`fixture-visual-app,fixture-workspace`) does not select these specs, so the mismatch escaped post-merge validation.

## Impact

- Trusted E2E evidence for the Claude App surface is red for any Issue that selects these regression IDs; #3779 PR #3900 is blocked at its required-by-plan E2E check.
- This is a test-coverage/navigation defect, not an observed production UI regression: the #3829 App renders the conversation-first surface by design.

## Fix Direction

Migrate only the App sections of the two specs to the #3829 surface while preserving their asserted invariants:

- conversation list: reach the list via `claude-app-all-conversations` or Browse → `claude-browse-conversations`; keep asserting the `conversation-list-error` warning and stale rows after Retry.
- transcript geometry: Browse → `claude-browse-transcripts` → `claude-app-transcript` → `claude-app-record` → `claude-app-record-raw` / `claude-app-raw`; keep the push-depth, one-Back and horizontal-overflow invariants.
- Leave the Web sections unchanged.

Verify the focused specs locally with the web-only profile and require the exact-head selected E2E run to pass.

## Location

- `e2e/tests/browser/conversation-list-state.spec.ts` (App push composition)
- `e2e/tests/browser/transcript-geometry.spec.ts` (transcript raw records on App)
- Owners: `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/ClaudeCodeAppWorkspace.tsx`, `web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/claude-app/*`

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 The App sections of `conversation-list-state` and `transcript-geometry` drive the #3829 conversation-first App workspace and pass at the exact PR head without weakening their asserted list-error/stale-row and transcript push/raw invariants.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pass | run 44263944349; ref c9ec0ecc345f208ae73607c8129c5860e6f9cb6f; source agent-qwen; file: e2e/tests/browser/conversation-list-state.spec.ts:59-89 — App push composition drives claude-code-app-workspace → claude-app-all-conversations → claude-app-conversations; preserves conversation-list-error + 3 stale rows after Retry; file: e2e/tests/browser/transcript-geometry.spec.ts:150-207 — App section drives claude-code-app-workspace → claude-app-root → Browse/claude-browse-transcripts → claude-app-transcript → claude-app-record → claude-app-record-raw → claude-app-raw; asserts single app-page-back, transcript-raw-inspector data-variant=pushed, horizontal overflow ≤ 1 at 390 and 375; file: web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/ClaudeCodeAppWorkspace.tsx:45,79,87 — renders claude-code-app-workspace and claude-app-root / claude-app-layer-${kind} consumed by the specs; file: web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/claude-app/ConversationRoutes.tsx:20,141 — renders claude-app-conversations and claude-app-all-conversations; file: web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/claude-app/TranscriptRoutes.tsx:15,37,76,89,111 — renders claude-app-transcripts/transcript/record/record-raw/raw; file: web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/claude-app/primitives.tsx:123,144 — claude-browse-sheet and claude-browse-transcripts entry; file: web/src/capabilities/claude-code/components/TranscriptRawInspector.tsx:205-206 — transcript-raw-inspector carries data-variant, used with variant='pushed' in App path; workflow: PR head c9ec0ecc3 commit message 'test(e2e): drive the App regression specs through the #3829 workspace' is the targeted migration; Web sections of both specs unchanged; summary: Both App sections now navigate the #3829 conversation-first surface (claude-code-app-workspace → claude-app-root / Browse sheet), retain the list-error + stale-row invariants in conversation-list-state and the push-depth / one-Back / horizontal-overflow invariants in transcript-geometry, and all referenced test IDs are rendered by the #3829 App component tree at the exact PR head. |

## E2E Verification

### New

- none: this is a test-navigation repair of existing regression specs; no new browser spec is needed

### Regression

- conversation-list-state
- transcript-geometry

## Prototype

- **Decision: Not needed.** No product interaction or visual behavior changes; only the test navigation to the already-shipped #3829 App surface.

### Knowledge Impact

- Decision: None
- Related knowledge: none
- Reason: test-only maintenance; no durable product or architecture decision changes
- Owner and timing: not applicable
- Evidence: the failing run and the #3829 App component tree above

## Product alignment

- [x] VISION.md: the App surface continues to work as shipped; this only restores its regression evidence.
- [x] PRINCIPLE.md: no new product surface is introduced.
- [x] Existing #3829 App behavior remains canonical.
- [x] No deviation from product behavior is proposed.

---
**Status:** Approved (test-only repair of an observed regression-evidence gap; no product change)
